title: Pujar i baixar pel mateix pendent

ref: figura-anisotropia-pendent
format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute: {echo: false, warning: false}
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs: [context/inputs/accessibilitat-ampliada.json]
  outputs: [assets/img/generated/anisotropia-pendent.svg]
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():root=root.parent
controls=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/accessibilitat-ampliada.json').read_text())['controls']
assert abs(controls['ramp_check']['up']['seconds']-132)<.01
assert abs(controls['ramp_check']['down']['seconds']-52.002)<.01
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':15,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(9.5,4.8))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.04,right=.98,bottom=.09,top=.84,wspace=.12)
for ax,direction,color in zip(axes,['up','down'],['#bb492f','#147b6b']):
    ax.set(xlim=(-10,110),ylim=(-14,27));ax.axis('off')
    ax.fill_between([0,100],[0,10],[-2,-2],color='#ece7d8')
    ax.plot([0,100],[0,10],color='#716647',lw=3)
    ax.plot([0,100,100],[0,0,10],color='#999999',ls='--',lw=1.3)
    ax.text(50,-2.9,'100 m horitzontals',ha='center')
    ax.text(104,5,'10 m',rotation=90,ha='center',va='center')
    start,end=((12,3),(88,10.6)) if direction=='up' else ((88,14),(12,6.4))
    ax.annotate('',xy=end,xytext=start,arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-|>','color':color,'lw':3,'mutation_scale':20})
    title='A · Pujar 10 m' if direction=='up' else 'B · Baixar 10 m'
    formula='0,72 × 100 + 6 × 10' if direction=='up' else '0,72 × 100 − 1,9998 × 10'
    time='132 s = 2,20 min' if direction=='up' else '52 s ≈ 0,87 min'
    ax.set_title(title,loc='left',fontsize=18,weight='bold',color=color,pad=12)
    ax.text(50,22,time,ha='center',fontsize=19,weight='bold',color=color)
    ax.text(50,-7,formula,ha='center',fontsize=14)
    ax.text(50,-11,'Mateix perfil · fricció addicional 0',ha='center',fontsize=13)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/anisotropia-pendent.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
